title: Universal Data Workbench
summary: Import CSV and Parquet tables and inspect every column on this device: row counts, source and inferred types with their uncertainty, semantic roles that keep identifiers apart from measures, missing values, values that do not read, unusual values, suspected data errors and corrections that wait for approval, with a log of every conversion. Then every valid chart of a documented grammar is drawn for each table, each candidate accounted for as valid, excluded, failed or incomplete, with field, transformation, label, scale, layout and facet edits. DuckDB 1.5.4 runs in the browser; files never leave the device. A preview: step 2 of 7.
